cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.
